hypothesis: EXP-E1-ERROR-PARTITION-001's DOWNSTREAM-LIMITED verdict is not an artifact of its affine oracle: a targeted fixed-point search for the matching output that would make the refinement stage correct also fails to remove the error.
training: none -- trained H2 checkpoints, inference and substitution only
method: initial <- clamp(initial + alpha*a*(gt - final), 0, 11) where gt > 0, 8 iterations at each alpha in [1.0, 0.5, 0.25], a = the candidates-per-pixel slope measured in run 001; model's own initial elsewhere
supersedes: EXP-E1-ERROR-PARTITION-002-INVERSE-ORACLE, whose update was not scaled by a and diverged -- see its NOTE.md
split: hailo_val, all 40 scenes, pooled over gt > 0
known_limitation: a clamped fixed point searches inputs to THESE refinement weights; it says nothing about a refinement stage retrained against a perfect matching input.
